card.name: Sentence ends in adverse-event findings
card.fires_on: Sentence-ending periods or closing parentheses after a clinical finding, such as a rate, duration or outcome in warnings text. Also a few linking words like "at" or "on" late in such a sentence.

modes.label: Period after finding
modes.description: The full stop closing a sentence that reports an adverse reaction, timing or outcome.
modes.example: most frequently reported within 7 days of therapy initiation<<.>> AJOVY was discontinued in many

modes.label: Closing parenthesis after statistics
modes.description: A closing parenthesis and period after a range or p-value.
modes.example: The median duration was 1.5 months (range: 5 days to 25+ months<<).>> Immune-mediated pneumonitis led to

modes.label: Linking word in a finding
modes.description: A short word like at or on inside a long descriptive clause about symptoms or follow-up.
modes.example: progress over days to weeks, and include progressive weakness<< on>> one side of the body or clumsiness

card.plain: It fires at the end of a sentence that reports a side effect result, just before the next sentence starts.
